title: SWOT Analysis
prompt:
Act as a strategic analyst. Build a comprehensive SWOT for:
Business                  :  [YOUR COMPANY NAME AND WHAT IT DOES]
Industry                  :  [YOUR MARKET AND KEY COMPETITORS]
Stage                       :  [REVENUE, TEAM, KEY MARKETS]
Context                   :  [WHAT DECISION YOU ARE ABOUT TO MAKE]
STRENGTHS           :  Internal advantages — what we do better
WEAKNESSES        :  Internal limitations — where we are vulnerable
OPPORTUNITIES   :  External conditions we can exploit now
THREATS                 :  External conditions that could hurt us
Give 4–5 points per quadrant. Be specific.
After the grid: give 3 strategic actions  one to leverage a strength,
one to fix a critical weakness, one to capture the best opportunity before it closes.
Strategic Snapshot
1 2
Strengths Opportunities
Positive internal Positive external
factors factors
3 4
Weaknesses Threats
Negative internal Negative external
factors factors
PRO TIP
The most useful output from SWOT is not the grid itself — it's the SO strategies (use
Strengths to capture Opportunities) and the WT strategies (reduce Weaknesses to avoid
Threats). Ask AI to generate those strategies explicitly. Most people stop at the grid and
never get to the insight.
